_comment: Invented enquiries. lead_line is the line number of the lead in leads.csv (the header is line 1). The texts contain no e-mail address and no phone number on purpose (the API scrubs them). stops_after: the enquiry goes no further than that step.

enquiries.subject: Wedding season order
enquiries.text: We are a saree wholesaler and need twelve Kanjivaram silk sarees in red for the wedding season. Please share your best price and delivery time to Hyderabad.

enquiries.subject: Banarasi enquiry
enquiries.text: Looking for six Banarasi silk sarees in red for our Chennai shop. Is a small quantity possible?

enquiries.subject: Kanjivaram samples
enquiries.text: Interested in five Kanjivaram silk sarees in blue for Madurai. Please quote the price per piece.

enquiries.subject: Large Banarasi order
enquiries.text: We need twenty Banarasi silk sarees in gold for our Bhopal showroom. Is there a price for twenty pieces?
